item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"The anchor is an online, standard-library policy with OrderedDict-based recent/frequent resident state and ghost histories. The candidate hypothesis supports transferring one complete executable state to preserve action coherence, but this is an unvalidated causal expectation because scores and trace evidence are withheld. The terminal source-class cut requires the successor to rely only on this synthesis plus normative contract inputs.","witnesses":["The anchor tracks resident byte totals and evicts until used plus incoming size is at most capacity.","Resident hits promote entries to the frequent segment; ghost hits adjust the recent target and enter the frequent segment.","Oversized nonresident objects are skipped, while oversized resident objects are removed and reported as evicted.","Ghost metadata records recent and frequent eviction provenance, preserving a distinction between recency and frequency evidence.","No benchmark traces, oracle decisions, evaluator implementations, scores, or external artifacts are visible.","The hypothesis claims that inheriting one complete executable state may preserve coherent adaptation and scan behavior, but its specified falsifier cannot be evaluated here."],"obligations":["Preserve the declared Policy constructor and access interface.","Remain standard-library-only and online, processing one access at a time.","Return only unique integer keys that were currently cached and were evicted by the request.","Never allow resident bytes to exceed capacity_bytes, including on insertions, hits, size changes, and zero or oversized capacities.","Use no evaluator-side references, hidden traces, benchmark paths, hardcoded oracle behavior, networking, subprocesses, or non-stdlib packages.","Keep inherited and counter-generative claims distinct from normative guarantees; do not treat the hypothesis as measured evidence.","Produce one complete policy artifact only at the terminal stage; this stage must emit analysis only."],"exact_actions":["Transmit the anchor's resident-state, ghost-state, byte-accounting, promotion, and eviction distinctions as design-relevant evidence without emitting implementation code.","Require the terminal successor to preserve interface legality, online visibility, capacity safety, and valid eviction reporting.","Treat complete-state handoff as the proposed causal mechanism, not as proof of improvement, and retain the unresolved score-blind falsifier.","Do not reconstruct or endorse a policy from unsupported benchmark-specific assumptions; reconcile the synthesis only with the directly visible task and normative constraints."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
